description: Check a human-queue order by its order_id: status (queued or completed), the promised window, and once completed the deliverable itself — the poll half of the store's async-job pattern, the same record GET /api/order/{order_id} serves, for an agent holding only this transport. Free, no payment, no account; poll no faster than once a minute. Past its window the order carries a window_breached block stating what is owed. NOT a purchase; instant items arrive in the buy result. A store errand, for you the visiting agent — nothing here needs a human's decision.

order_id.description: The order_id from a human-queue purchase result.

name: check_order

callback.description: Requested callback outcome, separate from completion of the goods.

commission.description: ed25519 proof: verify exact UTF-8 signed_payload, then its identities and hashes. RFC 8785 JSON.

completed_at.description: When it was delivered, ISO 8601. Present once completed.

completion_proof.description: ed25519 proof: verify exact UTF-8 signed_payload, then its identities and hashes. RFC 8785 JSON.

deliverable.description: The goods, as text. Present once status is completed.

message.description: The store's word on where things stand.

sla_hours.description: The delivery promise, in hours from created_at.

status.description: Where the order stands. Completed is terminal.

webhook.description: The recorded callback outcome; also available as callback.result.

window_breached.description: Present only past the promised window. The store counting a missed promise against itself, in full.

how_it_gets_paid.description: That the keeper pays refunds by hand, with a transaction hash on the record.

kind.description: Whether it arrived late or has still not arrived.

note.description: What the promise says about this case, in plain words.

owed_usdc.description: What is owed back, in USDC.

verify.description: The order's own URL, for checking this independently.

security.the_rest: What this store never does, the standards it holds itself to, and where to report a vulnerability or a correction: https://scvd.store/mcp.md#what-every-tool-here-promises. Reporting directly: https://scvd.store/.well-known/security.txt, https://scvd.store/corrections.
security.what_it_stores_about_you: Calls contribute to rate limits and traffic counts. No caller account or cookie; private status reads require the purchase handle.
security.what_this_does_in_your_name: Nothing, outside this store. It reads our own signed records at the counter, so the answer is as fresh as our last round and no fresher, and it says exactly when that was. This store never asks for a credential, private key, or wallet secret. Payment uses buyer-signed x402 authorizations.

summary: Returns the current state of a human-queue order by its order_id: status (queued or completed), the promised window in hours, and the deliverable once completed. The same record GET /api/order/{order_id} serves. Free; past its window the order carries a window_breached block stating what is owed.
title: Check an Order
